notes: Formosa Cafe Lana Turner scene, Jack's $50 payola left as a tip at the Frolic Room, Exley taking the Nite Owl homicide call and the Victory Motel as Dudley's interrogation base all confirmed on movie-locations.com. Dudley's note prints in the postcard hand after 'Rough night. Wrote this anyway.' with no quote marks; the words are his real line.

vibe.verdict: A Victory Motel postcard with real 1953 venues, cent prices and the right lines; a fan would grin at 'She is Lana Turner' on the egg rolls.
